results.fact: Height where the glacier is left / length of summit scramble
results.correct_value: Leave the glacier ~7,700 ft; the gully puts you ~300-400 ft below the summit (waypoint 7,950 ft); the finish after the notch is short (~150 ft summit gully), not 400-600 ft.
results.evidence: Eric's Base Camp puts the Snowfield-Horseman ridge at ~7,700 ft and about 300-400 vertical ft of class 3/4 scrambling above it; Lemke reached the dry ridge at 7,800 ft. The route description on the Mountaineers route page gives the final south-side summit gully as about 150 ft. So leaving at 7,700 and a gully that tops out 300-400 ft below the summit is consistent (the gully makes up the difference), and the whole rock section from the glacier (~650 ft) fits pitch_detail's 400-600 ft; only the summit waypoint's '400-600 ft' AFTER the notch is wrong.
